description: R08 functional-debt checkpoint: close the complete Microsoft til RectangleTests.cpp family with a dedicated safe Rust rectangle algebra owner and direct Microsoft-derived witnesses.

sourceRules.notes: The dedicated safe Rust TilRect owner reproduces all 58 Microsoft RectangleTests contracts: construction/value semantics, validity, union/intersection/subtraction, point translation, checked scale up/down, accessors and narrow casts, containment, bounded row-major point/index mapping including the Microsoft overflow vector, portable projections of SMALL_RECT/RECT/D2D/WinRT values, row-major iterator observables, and ceiling/floor/round float conversion. Native layout reinterpretation is not required by any source test method and no platform API is invoked.
